info.title: Selfhosted Observe API
info.description: Query API of the self-hosted @nestjs/observe collector. Timestamps are ISO strings, durations are milliseconds.

avgDurationMs.description: Mean duration (ms), null when the bucket has no requests.

lastSeenAt.description: Most recent telemetry from any of its applications.

avgDurationMs.description: Mean request duration (ms) in the range.

activity.description: Requests per bucket over the range, gap-filled.

slug.description: URL-safe and unique; generated from the name at creation and never changed.
URL-safe and unique; generated from the name at creation and never changed.

description.description: null or an empty string clears it.

lastSeenAt.description: Last telemetry batch received (updated at most every 30 s).

cpuPercent.description: Latest runtime sample in the range (any instance), percent of one core.

memoryPercent.description: Latest runtime sample in the range, percent of OS memory used by RSS.

memoryRssMb.description: Latest runtime sample in the range, RSS in megabytes.

activity.description: Requests per bucket over the range, gap-filled.

errorRate.description: Ratio 0..1 of failed requests in the range.

lastSeenAt.description: Last telemetry batch received (updated at most every 30 s).

lastUsedAt.description: Last authenticated ingest (updated at most once a minute).

secret.description: The agent's `appSecret`, sent as `x-api-secret`. Returned only once, at creation.

keyId.description: Public key id: the agent's `appKey`, sent as `x-api-key`.

lastSeenAt.description: Last telemetry batch received (updated at most every 30 s).

apiKey.description:
The application's first API key (active, no expiry). Its `secret` is returned only
here, once.

lastUsedAt.description: Last authenticated ingest (updated at most once a minute).

keyId.description: Public key id: the agent's `appKey`, sent as `x-api-key`.

applicationId.description: Application (of this project) the key sends telemetry for.

expiresAt.description: Omit or null for no expiry. Must be in the future.

status4xx.description: Requests with statusCode 400-499 (always 0 for jobs and error occurrences).

status5xx.description: Requests with statusCode >= 500 (always 0 for jobs and error occurrences).

groups.description: Error groups seen in the range.

jobsTimeline.description: Job runs per bucket (errors = failed runs), gap-filled, same buckets as `timeline`.

startOffsetMs.description: Start offset from the operation start, in ms.

error.description: Error details, or `true` when the span failed without details.

culprit.description: operationId or `queue/name` where it happens most.

serviceId.description: Instance (serviceId) of the most recent occurrence.

executionId.description: Request or job id, links to its detail route.

culprit.description: operationId or `queue/name` where it happens most.

occurrences.description: Most recent occurrences in the time range.

serviceId.description: Instance (serviceId) of the most recent occurrence.

logs.description: Logs carrying this trace id, oldest first.

cpuPercent.description: Percent of one core, as reported by the agent.

cpuUserMs.description: CPU time in user mode during the bucket (ms, summed).

cpuSystemMs.description: CPU time in kernel mode during the bucket (ms, summed).

memoryPercent.description: RSS as percent of OS memory.

latest.description: Newest sample in the range, null when there is none.

lastSeenAt.description: Time of its newest runtime sample.
